detailed_descriptions.en: Tower Tactics II, the fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock mythical powers, and deploy an ungodly amount of creative towers to overcome new strategic challenges and relentless waves of enemies. Tower Tactics II enters Early Access already bigger than its predecessor, with a massive amount of content to master: 5 playable characters with unique card pools and gameplay strategies 10 Ascension levels to conquer 190+ tower and spell cards 150 trinkets to shape your builds and give every run a unique spin 15 story quests 100+ hours of gameplay 4 additional game modes: Survival, Maze Builder, Sandbox, and Crystal Mines Steam Workshop integration Full controller and Steam Deck support No plan survives every wave. Face the relentless Sal'koth and stop them from turning the universe into a cold, dark void. Build your defenses around an arsenal of towers, spells, then adapt your strategy as new threats emerge. Deploy Hero Cards , make use of powerful relics , and turn status effects like Burn, Poison, and Frail to your advantage. Face new combat types, golden elite enemies, and challenging encounters that force you to rethink your strategy from one wave to the next. Every run starts before the first card is drawn. Customize your loadout with different starting Hero Cards and trinkets to shape your strategy. Between runs, return to the Sanctuary and place Offerings to expand your options and prepare for the challenges ahead. We will continue to grow with new cards, enemies, tiles, decks, game modes, maps, trinkets, and more. Your feedback is key to making Tower Tactics 2 even better, which is why we're launching in Early Access! Join the conversation, share your ideas, and help shape the future of the game on the Steam Forums and the official Discord server !

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Tower Tactics II, the fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock mythical powers, and deploy an ungodly amount of creative towers to overcome new strategic challenges and relentless waves of enemies.

Tower Tactics II enters Early Access already bigger than its predecessor, with a massive amount of content to master:

  •  5 playable characters with unique card pools and gameplay strategies

  •  10 Ascension levels to conquer

  •  190+ tower and spell cards

  •  150 trinkets to shape your builds and give every run a unique spin

  •  15 story quests

  •  100+ hours of gameplay

  •  4 additional game modes: Survival, Maze Builder, Sandbox, and Crystal Mines

  •  Steam Workshop integration

  •  Full controller and Steam Deck support

No plan survives every wave. Face the relentless Sal'koth and stop them from turning the universe into a cold, dark void. Build your defenses around an arsenal of towers, spells, then adapt your strategy as new threats emerge.

Deploy Hero Cards, make use of powerful relics, and turn status effects like Burn, Poison, and Frail to your advantage. Face new combat types, golden elite enemies, and challenging encounters that force you to rethink your strategy from one wave to the next.

Every run starts before the first card is drawn.

Customize your loadout with different starting Hero Cards and trinkets to shape your strategy. Between runs, return to the Sanctuary and place Offerings to expand your options and prepare for the challenges ahead.

We will continue to grow with new cards, enemies, tiles, decks, game modes, maps, trinkets, and more.

Your feedback is key to making Tower Tactics 2 even better, which is why we're launching in Early Access! Join the conversation, share your ideas, and help shape the future of the game on the Steam Forums and the official Discord server!
